creative_constraints.direction: strictly left to right, song time determines X. no backtracking
creative_constraints.ground_truth: Suno lyric start/end (model derived) + human final listening verification
creative_constraints.default_composition: One continuous walking path and consistent horizon across all 106 line images; a glass/stone/gold architectural motif ties scenes together
creative_constraints.preceding_image_requirement: MUST be supplied (actual prior accepted image) as reference for every line after the first, not just a text description
creative_constraints.seam_protection: The visible rightmost region of prior image is inserted unmodified into the left context of next image; extend/outpaint only to RIGHT.
creative_constraints.overlap: Provider-specific, provisionally 25-40% of image width. Calibrate after first 3 consecutive generation tests; no arbitrary alpha blending or unreviewed cropping.
creative_constraints.why_not_crossfade: Crossfading two separately generated pictures creates ghosting and changing pixels, not a single still mosaic. Seam matching must be achieved by locked context/outpainting or explicit inpainting of a frozen composite before the final still is committed.
creative_constraints.no_visual_animation: The source artwork must be a frozen picture. Only actual 3D camera changes position/rotation/lens during song.
